# Share continuous-parameter mapping admissibility

GitHub: https://github.com/misofm/engine/issues/669

Parent: #560 (lane B, CP8)

CP8 still duplicates the same continuous-parameter mapping/minimum rule in
`effect-contract`'s typed descriptor validator and `effect-package`'s borrowed
wire validator. This issue extracts only that rule into one pure parts predicate
owned by `effect-contract` and makes both production validators call it. It is
the next smallest closable CP8 product slice; the rest of the descriptor-law
duplication remains open under #560.

Sol HIGH coordinates the issue, documentation, checkpoints, GitHub
synchronization, and artifact qualification/pinning. The sole implementation
executor is Luna HIGH `/root/issue583_luna_impl`. Per the current user routing,
Astra LOW performs every scope,
implementation, exact-head, integration, artifact-applicability, and delivery
verification that would otherwise use Sol HIGH/XHIGH. Lane-A #668 owns only its
limiter evidence spec and compact lowering evidence. Its product and artifact
scope is disjoint from this issue. #668 and #669 are the two active issue slots.

## Exact ownership and outcome

Production ownership is limited to:

- `crates/effect-contract/src/lib.rs`
- `crates/effect-package/src/wire.rs`

Inline tests in those files and this numbered spec/evidence are also allowed.
Introduce one plainly named public pure predicate in `effect-contract` over
exactly `ParameterMapping` and the continuous parameter's `f32` minimum. The
predicate must allocate nothing, perform no I/O, expose no wire vocabulary, and
state the existing mapping admissibility law after the caller's existing
canonical-finite-minimum precondition:

- `Linear` and `Exponential` are admissible.
- `Logarithmic` is admissible only when the minimum is strictly greater than
  positive zero.
- `Stepped` is not admissible for a continuous parameter.

Replace only the duplicated mapping `matches!` expression and logarithmic
minimum comparison in `parameter_valid` and `parameter_semantics_valid` with
calls to that predicate. Preserve every statement before and after it in the
existing order, including text, default, bounds, signed-zero, default-in-range,
choice-count, automation, and smoothing validation.

Do not share another descriptor predicate. Do not change mapping formulas,
enum values, parameter domains, bounds/default behavior, enum choices, wire
layout/schema/version, offsets, diagnostics, canonicalization, dependencies,
public descriptor structs, effect-runtime behavior, DSP, compiler behavior,
artifacts, pins, workflows, or policies. If the helper requires another
abstraction, changes an accepted/rejected descriptor, or broadens ownership,
stop and return for rescope.

## Objective gates

1. Before implementation, push and synchronize this brief and #560, then
   obtain Astra LOW exact clean scope PASS.
2. Prove the predicate with an independent mapping/minimum truth table. Cover
   all four mapping variants with negative finite, negative zero, positive
   zero, smallest positive, and ordinary positive minima. State explicitly that
   nonfinite and negative-zero descriptor minima are rejected by the callers'
   unchanged earlier canonical preconditions, and exercise those preconditions
   without deriving expected results from the production predicate.
3. Exercise both production callers. Preserve typed-versus-borrowed descriptor
   parity for every mapping, zero-sign boundary, finite sign boundary, and
   nonfinite minimum. Retain the exact accepted and rejected descriptor set.
4. Preserve wire diagnostic phase, code, parameter index, record index, byte
   offset, rejection precedence, and canonical encoded bytes. No parser or
   validation reordering may occur.
5. After the source and independent tests are complete, run these literal gates
   once in this order from the worktree root, with
   `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/issue669-attempt1-target` for every Cargo command:
   `cargo test --locked -p effect-contract`; `cargo test --locked -p
   effect-package`; `cargo test --locked --release -p effect-contract`; `cargo
   test --locked --release -p effect-package`; `cargo clippy --locked -p
   effect-contract -p effect-package --all-targets --all-features -- -D
   warnings`; `cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `bash
   scripts/check-effect-runtime-policy.sh`; `bash
   scripts/check-effect-package-v1.sh`; `bash
   scripts/check-effect-descriptor-v1.sh`; `bash
   scripts/check-workspace-policy.sh`; `git diff --check`. No benchmark or
   timing invocation is authorized; this issue makes no performance claim.
6. Root checkpoints each coherent green tranche before more implementation.
   Astra LOW reviews the exact pushed source/evidence head and again after any
   current-main integration.
7. After source PASS, root owns an ordinary artifact applicability ruling. If
   generated bytes are unchanged, record the exact identity proof and retain
   the current pin. If bytes drift, stop and split qualification/pinning into a
   bounded successor that preserves the repository's static, resource,
   hermetic, SDK, browser, and mutation gates. Full compiler streams and `.ll`
   or `.s` captures are temporary diagnostics only and must never be committed.
8. Open one PR only after the reviewed branch is ready. Require the repository's
   `qualification` check to succeed, verify live main immediately before the
   guarded exact-head merge, verify merge parents and post-main qualification,
   synchronize #560 and this issue, then remove the clean delivered worktree.

One Luna implementation pass is initially authorized. A substantive finding
receives at most the remaining attempts under the repository's three-attempt
rule. No gate may be weakened and no fourth disguised retry is allowed.
